compare.tabHint: Compare with another driver: gap within the lap, traces by distance and a ghost on the map. Also with Shift+click on the leaderboard; Esc goes back to live telemetry.
compare.ghostHint: Ghost: draws on the map the real position of the compared driver on their reference lap, at the same lap time as the selected one.
compare.ghostHintEstimated: Ghost: draws on the map the reconstructed position (Estimated) of the compared driver on their reference lap, at the same lap time as the selected one.
compare.empty: Choose who to compare with from the list, or Shift+click on the leaderboard.
compare.deltaLabel: Gap between {a} and {b} within the lap:
compare.deltaTitle: Lap time of {a} minus that of {b} at the same point of the lap: positive, {a} is slower; negative, faster.

missing.noLapA: No data: it is not known which lap {a} is on right now
missing.noPositionA: No data: there is no position for {a} when lap {lap} starts
missing.noLapBest: No data: {b} had no valid lap with an official time yet
missing.noLapLast: No data: {b} had not completed any lap yet (lap 1 does not count)
missing.noPosition: No data: there are no positions for {b} on their lap {lap}

compare.officialPending: L{lap} official: once {b} finishes their lap {lapB}

ghostState.notYet: Ghost: {b} had not reached that lap time yet
ghostState.finished: Ghost: {b} had already finished their lap
ghostState.noData: Ghost: no data (no position for {b} at that moment)

compare.hint: The live gap comes from the GPS positions of both cars at the same point of the lap: it is an estimate and only tenths are given. When the lap ends, the official figure from the lap times.
compare.hintTraces: The traces are the real telemetry samples; only their place on the distance axis comes from GPS (about ±8 m).
compare.hintTracesEstimated: The traces are this session’s reconstructed telemetry (Estimated: it does not come as is from the source); their place on the distance axis comes from the positions.
compare.hintGhost: The ghost is the real position of the other car on its reference lap, shifted in time; with more than {gap} s without a position it is not drawn.
compare.hintGhostEstimated: The ghost is the reconstructed position of the other car on its reference lap (Estimated: it does not come as is from the source), shifted in time; with more than {gap} s without a position it is not drawn.
compare.hintRefs: The best and last laps are fixed when the selected driver's lap starts; the best lap is never lap 1 or a deleted lap. Nothing comes from the future: if the other car has not reached that point yet, the comparison is made where it is.
compare.roleATitle: Car A of the comparison (the selected one)
compare.roleBTitle: Car B of the comparison (Shift+click to remove it)
